evidence.citation: “Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C—with one fresh, context-free runner per case… B now passes… A and C still pass, demonstrating no regressions… [and] the live checkout was inspected after the runs and any leaked artifacts were removed.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The complete re-evaluation verifies the targeted fix and checks previously passing cases for regressions; fresh runners, independent judging, checkout inspection, cleanup, and the before/after report protect isolation, integrity, provenance, and reproducibility. These are necessary controls under the supplied bar.
